vectors.name: classes-entrenched-fail: Marking a section entrenched needs the entrenched bar: all 10 members score it, an average of 2.9 with no zeros, so it closes early and fails, and the section stays ordinary
classes-entrenched-pass: Marking a section entrenched at an average of exactly 3.0 with no zeros passes when the tenth ballot closes it early, and the section becomes entrenched from that minute
classes-eternal-fail: Marking a section eternal needs the entrenched bar: all 10 members score it, an average of 2.9 with no zeros, so it closes early and fails, and the section stays ordinary
classes-eternal-pass: Marking a section eternal at an average of exactly 3.0 with no zeros passes when the tenth ballot closes it early, and the section becomes eternal from that minute
classes-unprotect-fail: removing a section's protection is itself entrenched (ADR-0015 §2): at an average of 2.9 with no zeros it fails, and the section stays entrenched
classes-unprotect-pass: removing a section's protection at an average of exactly 3.0 with no zeros passes, and the section is ordinary again: its next edit runs 7 days at the ordinary bar
classes-entrenched-to-eternal: an entrenched section can be made eternal by an entrenched vote; a fail leaves it entrenched, a pass makes it eternal
